reasons.min_ram_mb:
RAM corrected 4096 -> 2048 (Wave 38 row 38.4, 2026-09-16, rule #59): EVE-NG's
own real vmxvcp.yml template (docs/reference/eveng-implementation/raw/
templates/vmxvcp.yml) says "ram: 2048", "cpu: 1" - the previous 4096 was
unexplained drift with no comment justifying it. Real-world evidence this
was wrong, not just a template mismatch: live-booting a real vmxvcp+vmxvfp
pair on an 8GB test VM (vmxvfp alone already needs 4096MB per EVE-NG's own
vmxvfp.yml) hit a genuine host-RAM admission refusal with the old 4096MB
vmxvcp value - 2048+4096=6144MB fits comfortably where 4096+4096=8192MB did
not, on hardware EVE-NG's own reference deployment is sized for.
reasons.day0_channel:
NPX-4606 (the project owner 4 Nov, no console typing): EVE-NG's config_vmxvcp.py types a mount +
"load set" sequence; netplex does not. vmxvcp is a FreeBSD Junos like vsrx/vqfxre, so
its day-0 text goes into the /config partition of its own overlay while it is off.

settings.notes: Control Plane - requires VMX VFP companion
